reviewNotes:
Foldboard is a custom keyboard (keyboard extension) designed for iPhone Duo, that also works on every iPhone.

To review it: open Foldboard, tap "Add Foldboard to your keyboards" and follow the 3 steps (Settings > Foldboard > Keyboards > turn on Foldboard and Allow Full Access). Then in any app, hold the globe key and pick Foldboard. The app also has a "Try it" field, and every settings screen shows the real keyboard at the bottom, so all features can be tried inside the app.

Features: one-hand keyboard on the left or right, full width, and a two-hand split keyboard (two halves at both edges, when the screen is wide like the open iPhone Duo). In "Follows your hand" mode the keyboard moves to the side of the hand holding the phone, using the device tilt and the gyroscope while the keyboard is on screen (GripSense method). Motion data is only kept in memory and never stored or sent. Auto-correction and word suggestions use UITextChecker on the device. Phrases and emoji can be inserted in one tap.

Full Access is only used for haptics, typing sounds and to share settings between the app and the keyboard through the keychain. The keyboard makes no network requests and never stores or sends what the user types. No account, no ads, no analytics.

In-app purchases: "3-day Trial" (com.padelup.foldboard.trial3) is a free non-consumable that starts a 3-day trial of every Pro feature, as allowed for non-subscription apps (Guideline 3.1.1); nothing renews. "Foldboard Pro" (com.padelup.foldboard.pro) is a one-time non-consumable that unlocks Pro features forever. Both are on the Foldboard Pro screen (tap the first card on the home screen), with Restore Purchases. One-hand left/right, full width, QWERTY/AZERTY and auto-correction stay free.
